evidence.root_cause: The bundled fallback matched only tree.name. Lite and Web BookStack share the same title, and the prior ZIP omitted the Lite suite, so the Web suite was selected silently.

changes: Copied frozen Lite BookStack and Lite Keep public tests into the bundle without editing them.
Added canonical JSON SHA-256 identities for all 13 bundled requirement trees.
Kept ARCBENCH_TESTS_DIR and /workspace/tests precedence, then required exact fingerprints for v2 bundled suites.
Kept unique-title compatibility for legacy manifests and disabled internal acceptance on ambiguity or mismatch.
Added Lite selection, Web selection, ambiguity, and legacy compatibility unit tests.

static_self_check_boundary.decision: Remain advisory because placeholder and dynamic-route checks can be false positives; do not force all findings into repair. Test-suite identity ambiguity disables bundled internal acceptance.

non_changes: Timeouts, request budgets, and repair rounds were not changed.
Official public test contents were not changed.
handoff: Upload only this exact ZIP and bind the next platform Run ID, task, submission/build identity, and ZIP SHA. The candidate is not GO until platform evidence confirms Lite tests are selected and final scoring improves.
